47-tucanae.d: The second brightest and most massive globular cluster in the Milky Way, located in Tucana.

local-interstellar-cloud.d: Partially ionised warm interstellar cloud (~7,000 K) in the Complex of Local Interstellar Clouds (CLIC) through which Sol is currently passing.

rho-ophiuchi-cloud.d: Dense dark nebula and active stellar nursery at the Upper Scorpius boundary of the Local Bubble, ~138 pc from Sol.
